ideas.pitch: A supply chain compliance and risk-detection platform leveraging graph intelligence and explainable ML for corporate procurement audits.
ideas.problem_statement: Business-oriented problem involving market analysis, risk evaluation, and engineering solutions for enterprise supply chains.
ideas.title: SupplyShield AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous business risk analysis with hard engineering (graph intelligence and explainable models), matching the exact winning formula of Bito at DIGITIMES.

ideas.pitch: An interactive analytics dashboard and optimization engine for tracking and cutting carbon footprints in regional commercial logistics.
ideas.problem_statement: Business-oriented problem focusing on operational efficiency, carbon footprint reduction, and data-driven market strategies.
ideas.title: LogiCarbon BI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages clear measurable economic and environmental impact with visual data reporting, replicating the success of the IBM Hackathon carbon footprint project.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agentic data pipeline inspector that detects data anomalies, runs evidence gates, and automatically proposes verified patches.
ideas.problem_statement: Business-oriented engineering challenge involving existing codebases, open-source development, and data reliability.
ideas.title: DataGuard Incident Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard agentic engineering with an evidence gate and automated write-back, mirroring the Grand Prize winner BlackBox DataHub.

ideas.pitch: A local market analysis tool for small businesses featuring competitive landscape mapping, automated pricing suggestions, and local foot-traffic insights.
ideas.problem_statement: Market research and business opportunity identification, target audience analysis, and competitor research.
ideas.title: MarketPath Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on business strategy, market research, and problem identification required for Round 1, combined with a working software prototype.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting platform that predicts regulatory and supply-chain operational incidents using statistical modeling and calibrated prediction intervals.
ideas.problem_statement: Business-oriented problem or scenario requiring market analysis, risk projection, and software implementation.
ideas.title: IncidentCast AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous quantitative forecasting with calibrated intervals, mirroring the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winning methodology.
